references.text: Joshua sent spies from Jericho, just as he had previously sent two spies to Jericho
Beth-aven is mentioned in connection with Ai and Bethel, confirming the geographical location
Bethel is mentioned as an important place in the history of the patriarchs, east of Ai
Bethel is identified as a holy place, mentioned in connection with Ai
The second sending of men to Ai, after Achan's sin was punished
Moses sent spies to explore the land, a pattern that Joshua follows here
Ai and Bethel are mentioned together in the list of defeated kings
The prophet Hosea warns against going to Beth-aven, showing the place's later negative reputation
